title: Brand Ambassador
company: Compass Group UK & Ireland Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Brand Ambassador

NHS Supply Chain: Food Foodbuy
Field Based / Mobile UK Travel Required

Be the Face and Voice of NHS Supply Chain: Food

Foodbuy is one of the UK's leading food procurement organisations, managing over £2bn of spend and supporting a diverse range of clients through market-leading procurement solutions. As part of Compass Group UK & Ireland, we combine scale, expertise and innovation to deliver outstanding value, insight and service.

At NHS Supply Chain: Food, we put the NHS at the heart of everything we do. Through trusted partnerships, procurement expertise and a deep understanding of healthcare catering and foodservice operations, we help NHS organisations deliver safe, efficient and sustainable food solutions.

We are now looking for an engaging and commercially minded Brand Ambassador to help strengthen our presence across the NHS, champion our proposition and create meaningful connections with customers, stakeholders and industry partners.

The Role

This is a highly visible and influential position that will act as the voice of both the customer and the brand. Working closely with our Operations, Account Management, Procurement and Marketing teams, you will be responsible for driving engagement, enhancing brand awareness and supporting commercial growth across NHS Supply Chain: Food.

You'll represent the organisation at customer meetings, industry events, exhibitions and conferences while gathering valuable market intelligence and customer insight that helps shape future campaigns, communications and engagement strategies.

This role would suit an ambitious relationship-builder with strong communication skills, a passion for customer engagement and the confidence to represent a nationally recognised organisation within the healthcare and foodservice sectors.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as a Brand Ambassador for NHS Supply Chain: Food across the UK.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with NHS stakeholders, customers and industry partners.
- Identify opportunities to strengthen and promote the NHS Supply Chain: Food proposition.
- Gather customer insights and market intelligence to support strategic decision making.
- Conduct competitor analysis and provide regular insight reports to business leaders.
- Develop content briefs, case studies, testimonials and customer success stories.
- Work collaboratively with Marketing and Communications teams to support campaigns and content creation.
- Attend and represent the organisation at exhibitions, conferences and networking events.
- Generate and track opportunities arising from events and engagement activities.
- Support speaking engagements, award submissions and thought leadership initiatives.
- Manage key industry relationships, including engagement with healthcare catering networks and associations.
- Contribute to the delivery of the annual marketing and engagement roadmap.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines strong stakeholder engagement skills with commercial awareness and a passion for building relationships.

Essential Experience & Skills
- Experience in a stakeholder engagement, customer-facing or brand ambassador role.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
- Ability to translate complex information into clear, engaging customer-focused messaging.
- Experience representing an organisation at customer meetings, events or exhibitions.
- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
- Experience gathering customer insights and analysing market trends.
- Experience creating content plans, marketing briefs or engagement campaigns.
- Experience working collaboratively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
- Proven ability to achieve measurable commercial or engagement outcomes.
- Strong organisational and project management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Desirable
- Experience within the NHS, healthcare or wider public sector.
- Foodservice, hospitality or food industry experience.
- Professional marketing qualification.
- Account management experience.
- Event management experience.
- CRM, website content or social media campaign experience.
- Experience working within procurement, supply chain or managed service environments.

What You'll Bring
- Energy, enthusiasm and credibility when engaging with customers and stakeholders.
- A customer-first mindset with a genuine interest in understanding client needs.
- Confidence speaking to groups, presenting ideas and representing the organisation publicly.
- Curiosity about market trends, competitor activity and industry developments.
- A proactive approach to identifying opportunities and driving continuous improvement.

Working Pattern
- Full-time position.
- Field-based role with regular travel across the UK.
- Flexible approach to working hours.
- Occasional evening and weekend attendance at events and industry activities may be required.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in shaping how NHS Supply Chain: Food is represented across the healthcare sector. You'll work with a passionate and collaborative team while helping drive engagement, innovation and growth across one of the UK's most important food procurement partnerships.

Join us and help make a positive impact on NHS foodservice operations across the UK.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

Location: Guildford
Salary: £28,000-£32,000 per annum, depending on experience

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Digital Marketing Executive to join a growing business based in Guildford. You'll join a fast-paced and collaborative marketing team, supporting the day-to-day delivery of digital content and campaigns across multiple platforms and helping to grow the company's online presence.

Key Responsibilities

You'll support the Digital Marketing Manager across the day-to-day running of marketing activity, including:
- Creating, filming and scheduling social media content.
- Photography and video content for stores, products and campaigns.
- Supporting email marketing campaigns.
- Creating and updating website content.
- Helping to coordinate influencer and content creator activity.
- Creating basic graphics and marketing materials.
- Supporting wider campaigns and ad hoc marketing projects.

Skills & Experience

We're looking for someone with:
- A genuine interest in digital marketing and content creation.
- Good photography and/or videography skills.
- Strong written English and communication skills.
- Good organisation and attention to detail.
- Confidence learning and using different digital platforms.
- Have a genuine interest in digital marketing, content and social media.
- Are creative, organised and have strong attention to detail.
- Are confident behind a camera and have a good eye for creating photo and video content.
- Have strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Are keen to learn and get involved across different areas of marketing.
- Experience Canva, WordPress, video editing software, and social media management platforms - Desirable

What's in It for You?
- Hands-on experience across a wide range of digital marketing activity.
- A clear pathway for progression within the marketing team.
- Training and support from the Digital Marketing Manager.
- The opportunity to work across a varied range of marketing projects.
- The opportunity to take on more responsibility as your skills develop.

Career Progression

There is clear opportunity to progress within the marketing team as your skills, experience and responsibilities develop.

Progression will be based on performance and development within the role.

title: Marketing Assistant/Website Administrator
description:
Digital Marketing & Website Assistant

Reigate, Surrey (hybrid) £30,000 Full-time, Monday-Friday, 8.45am-5pm (hybrid, post-probation)

Our client is a well-established, multi-brand retailer based in Reigate, known for its strong digital presence across ecommerce and content-led marketing. As the business continues to grow across its brands, they're looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing & Website Assistant to join the marketing team.

This is a brilliant opportunity for an early-career digital marketer who's confident across social, email and website platforms and wants to get stuck into a varied, creative role with real ownership.

What you'll be doing
- Planning and creating email marketing campaigns and flows in Klaviyo, including copy, subject lines and hero graphics
- Creating organic social media content - lifestyle images, reels and captions - across Meta, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
- Responding to social comments and queries, and providing creative assets for paid ad content
- Updating and maintaining ecommerce websites via Shopify - homepage, collection and product page banners, pop-ups, pricing and new products
- Managing WordPress content including product pages, galleries, landing pages and Elementor templates
- Maintaining brand guidelines and visual identity across web and digital assets
- Attending photoshoots and filming, and editing video content for reels and long-form

What we're looking for
- Some early-career marketing experience with practical exposure to digital and social platforms
- A good eye for design and confidence using tools such as Canva (video editing skills a bonus)
- Familiarity with Klaviyo, Shopify and/or WordPress is a plus, but a fast learner who can pick up new platforms is just as important
- Enthusiastic, organised and proactive, with the confidence to take ownership and get things done
- A car driver with use of a car, unless you're within walking distance of the office

What's in it for you
- £30,000 salary
- Hybrid working available after probation
- A varied, creative role spanning social, email and web
- Real ownership and room to bring your own ideas

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today, or get in touch for a confidential chat about the role

title: Part-Time Marketing Manager
description:
A rare job share opportunity for a Marketing Manager to work in the UK office of an international company with offices located within easy reach of Surrey/North Hampshire/London.

The role requires the successful candidate to work 22.5 hours per week, flexible over full days or part days.

Marketing Manager Benefits and Package:
- Working 22.5 hours per week
- Free Parking
- Discretionary Bonus Scheme
- Company Pension Scheme
- Salary Sacrifice Car Scheme
- Death In Service
- Mobile
- Laptop

Marketing Manager Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
- Responsible for writing & implementing annual marketing plan which aligns the UK and HO business strategy.
- Managing the UK Marketing Budget and ensuring effective delivery of the marketing plan including monitoring ROI.
- B2 C & B2 B promotional activities with aim of developing sales and brand awareness in key markets.
- Manage relationships with 2-3 key marketing agencies supporting B2 B and B2 C activity.
- Regular liaison with HO marketing function in Germany
- Plan and deliver participation at national and international conferences and exhibitions.
- Support Bid & Tender process.
- Co-ordinate production of all B2 C advertising - online & print.
- On an as required basis to co-ordinate, track & register sponsorship payments with the ABPI
- With support from colleagues ensure the UK office is aware of & adheres to compliance standards relevant to the pharma/medical device industries.
- Oversee UK website and ensure relevant content is maintained and updated.
- Ensure digital agency delivery for Google Ads, Meta Ads & Amazon Ads to maximise traffic to UK webshop & UK Amazon listings
- Proof translated documents to ensure good standard of Plain English to their respective audiences.
- Competitor analysis for key products
- Support relationships with partners and other key stakeholders.
- Collaborate and share workload effectively with job share marketing manager.
- As part of the Senior Leadership Team, actively participate Marketing & Sales meetings and Monthly Operations Team Meetings

Marketing Manager Qualities:
- Level 4 CIM or equivalent Marketing Qualification
- Experience of medical device or pharma industry highly desirable
- Strong B2 C and B2 B marketing experience (Digital and offline).
- ABPI qualification or willingness to take qualification within 12 months of joining
- IT knowledge e.g. Microsoft Office (essential), SAP, databases, Shopify
- Amazon Vendor or Seller experience
- Proven content writing and editing experience.
- Excellent communications skills
- Strong team player who has the flexibility and ability to work in a small UK operation (12 people) and support tasks outside of marketing.
- Must be able to work in the office (occasional flexibility possible)

Thank you for your application however due to the high volume of candidates applying, if you have not heard back from us within 5 days please assume that you have not been successful on this occasion.
